groups.name: Infrastructure, Leveraged Finance, Capital Markets & Alternatives
Sovereign Capital, Private Equity, Family Offices & M&A

people.name: Colin Pham
people.title: Founder & CEO
people.bio: Sets Arcovia’s direction, capital and investor strategy, and leads the firm’s major relationships and mandates. Led $330M+ in capital raised across 24 transactions and is the architect of the GENESIS outreach system. Founded a media company generating 600M+ organic views for Google, Microsoft, PepsiCo and Mercedes-Benz.

people.name: Caroline Farah Lembck
people.title: Co-Founder & Managing Principal, Capital Markets
people.bio: CEO of LemVega Capital ($1B AUM) across hedge funds, VC, PE and real estate. Began her career in business development at Genmab ($40B global biotech). Building LemVega International Bank; equity partner at Solid Rep IP.

people.name: Adil Amanullah
people.title: Principal
people.bio: Leads Arcovia’s transaction, venture and origination platform, from first screen to close. Runs the firm’s capital-intelligence engine: scout intake, AI-driven insights and investor mapping. Co-leads fund-to-fund partnerships and develops Arcovia’s investment talent through the Residency Program. Previously at LvlUp Ventures.

people.name: Lilla Váradi
people.title: Chief Investment Officer
people.bio: Leads investor relations, investment coordination, growth and operations. Co-leads key capital relationships and fund partnerships across the US, Europe and the Middle East. 6+ years in business development and operations; built a growth-stage real estate firm’s operating and partner platform from day one.

people.name: Ken Hershman
people.title: Senior Advisor, Media, Entertainment & Sports
people.bio: Former President of HBO Sports and EVP/GM of Showtime Sports; 25+ years across sports media, premium television and entertainment. Negotiated the joint HBO–Showtime broadcast of Mayweather vs. Pacquiao ($600M+ pay-per-view event). Advises boards, founders and funds through CTH Advisors on M&A, growth strategy, governance and media IP.

people.name: Jon Brodsky
people.title: Senior Advisor, Technology, Digital Media & Growth
people.bio: Former CEO of YouNow (global livestreaming network) and finder.com USA (1,000+ corporate clients). Former SVP Digital at Chicken Soup for the Soul, scaling to 1B content views per month. As Director of Corporate Development at 1-800-Flowers, added $300M+ in revenue through M&A.

people.name: Koyuki Nakamori
people.title: Senior Advisor, AI & Platform Architecture
people.bio: 14+ years of AI and Web3 leadership in Silicon Valley; Co-Founder and Chief AI Officer of Halo AI. Scaled ML teams at Nextdoor, Headspace, Ava Labs and the Opentensor Foundation.

people.name: Julian Smith
people.title: Senior Advisor, Infrastructure & Climate Finance (PwC)
people.bio: 38 years in international infrastructure and climate finance; PwC Partner 2002–2025. Advised on $15B+ of completed infrastructure finance, including the £5.2B UK Intercity Express PPP and the €900M+ Port of Gothenburg privatisation.

people.name: Kendall Holman
people.title: Senior Advisor, Middle Market M&A & Debt Capital Markets (Credit Suisse, JPMorgan)
people.bio: 40+ years and 315+ engagements valued at $11B+; built capital markets divisions at Synovus and SouthTrust Securities. $2.7B+ across 64 healthcare transactions and $1.3B+ across 53 governmental transactions.

people.name: Morgan Edwards
people.title: Senior Advisor, Leveraged Finance & FinTech (Morgan Stanley, Macquarie)
people.bio: 30 years at Morgan Stanley, Bear Stearns and Macquarie; $20B+ in LBO transactions for KKR, Blackstone, TPG, Carlyle, Apollo and Bain Capital. Led the $1.1B Dresser Industries LBO (Euromoney Deal of the Year); co-founded CommonBond and Orchard Platform.

people.name: Kristina McDonough
people.title: Senior Advisor, Capital Markets & Alternatives (Bank of America, Credit Suisse)
people.bio: 35 years across BofA, Credit Suisse, DLJ and HypoVereinsbank; founded or co-founded six platform companies. $10B+ raised across private equity, hedge fund and real estate platforms; 60–80 UHNW family relationships.

people.name: Nitan Pathak
people.title: Senior Advisor, Private Equity & Venture Capital
people.bio: 20+ years in private equity, venture capital and institutional portfolio construction. Senior Head of Unit at the European Investment Fund (EIB Group), with capital deployed across hundreds of PE and VC funds, and long-term partnerships with sovereign wealth funds and public pensions across Europe, the GCC and Asia-Pacific. Earlier at Raymond James (TMT M&A), Texas Instruments and KPMG; MBA, University of Oxford.

people.name: Stéphane Préfol
people.title: Senior Advisor, Cross-Border M&A
people.bio: 20+ years executing cross-border M&A: 50+ transactions in 20+ countries worth €5bn+. Head of M&A at Banijay, the world’s largest independent content producer, reporting to the CEO. Previously led international M&A at Publicis; earlier at Kepler Cheuvreux and Wagram Corporate Finance. Board member and adviser at Balich Wonder Studio, Chantelle and SPACLO.

people.name: Sunil Varma
people.title: Senior Advisor, Family Offices & GCC Investments
people.bio: 30+ years across family offices, investment banking, asset management and treasury; managed and deployed $2bn+ across public markets, private investments, real estate and alternatives. Strategic Investment Advisor to the Chairman of an Abu Dhabi single-family office; previously Director of Investments, Al Qassimi Group.

people.name: João Pedro Gonçalves
people.title: Senior Advisor, Sovereign & Sustainable Finance
people.bio: 25+ years advising governments, central banks and sovereign funds, including Saudi Arabia’s PIF and the funds of Brazil, Angola and Timor-Leste. Lead Sustainable & Innovative Finance Advisor at UNDP; led the first sovereign SDG bond and Uzbekistan’s first green bond. Professor of Economics & Finance; former Visiting Professor at the London School of Economics.

advisors_note: Senior advisors are independent professionals, not employees or registered representatives of Arcovia unless stated otherwise.
